premise: Hedgehog tries to nap but Squirrel's nibbling is too loud, so he curls into a ball, and Squirrel tiptoes away with her nut.
inspiration: The Princess and the Pea (Andersen), turned from a pea to a noise: the smallest thing keeps you awake, and a friend's kindness fixes it.
lesson: Noticing what a friend needs, and giving it quietly.
learning: A hedgehog rolls up into a round prickly ball

en-US.title: Hedgehog Wants a Nap
en-US.text: One lazy afternoon, Hedgehog {hedgehog:pulse} was sleepy. {hedgehog:live} He gave a big yawn, curled up into a round, prickly ball… then peeked out again, and uncurled. {sfx:nibble} Crunch, crunch, crunch! Right next to him, Squirrel was nibbling her hazelnut. [sighs] Crunch, crunch. Hedgehog couldn't sleep a wink. Mouse {mouse:hop} tiptoed over. [whispers] Squirrel, he said, Hedgehog is trying to nap. {squirrel:live} Squirrel stopped. She looked left and right. She hid her hazelnut behind her back… and gave it a little hug. Oops, she whispered. {squirrel:tint #FFB3C6} I'll save it for later. So Squirrel and Mouse tiptoed away, {mouse:fade-out} tip, tip, tip. [softly] And Hedgehog rolled up into his ball again, {hedgehog:glow} warm and round, and slept all afternoon.

es-ES.title: Erizo quiere echar la siesta
es-ES.text: Una tarde tranquila, Erizo {hedgehog:pulse} tenía mucho sueño. {hedgehog:live} Dio un gran bostezo, se hizo una bola redonda y pinchuda… luego asomó la nariz, y se desenrolló. {sfx:nibble} ¡Cronch, cronch, cronch! A su lado, Ardilla mordisqueaba su avellana. [sighs] Cronch, cronch. Erizo no conseguía dormirse. Ratón {mouse:hop} se acercó de puntillas. [whispers] Ardilla, le dijo, Erizo está intentando dormir la siesta. {squirrel:live} Ardilla se paró. Miró a un lado y a otro. Escondió la avellana detrás de la espalda… y le dio un abracito. Uy, susurró. {squirrel:tint #FFB3C6} La guardo para luego. Así que Ardilla y Ratón se fueron de puntillas, {mouse:fade-out} tip, tip, tip. [softly] Y Erizo se hizo otra vez una bola, {hedgehog:glow} calentita y redonda, y durmió toda la tarde.

nibble.prompt: a squirrel crunching a hazelnut with tiny quick nibbles
